description: Near-surface air temperature, about 2 m above the ground or sea surface. At the ground's own height: not reduced to sea level. Mean over month 5.

grid.projection: equirectangular (plate carree), longitude and latitude in degrees
grid.pixel_registration: area: pixel (i, j) covers the cell whose centre is at longitude -180 + (i + 0.5) * 360 / width, latitude 90 - (j + 0.5) * 180 / height

period.description: Long-term means of the settled climate, averaged over several simulated years. Annual amounts are the average year, not one particular year.
period.months: Twelve equal parts of this world's year.
period.month_1_start: The point of the orbit that corresponds to 1 January on Earth.
